_about: M1-ART-02 post-import rules for the Haluna kit (game/core/import/haluna_kit_post_import.gd, AssetImportRules). Materials and LOD ranges match HalunaDresser's defaults, which still override them at runtime with the layout's values. Walk collision for the playable zone is built at runtime by HalunaCollision; the kit exports no -col proxies yet, so the collision rules apply only when a piece gains one.
